verdict.rationale: Bento's marketing page says every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible (docs-15). Skills and rules live in the user's repo as Markdown/YAML (docs-16), and fixes graduate from candidate to promoted through shadow-mode scoring (docs-11, docs-12), which gives a review step. All of this is high-level marketing copy with no documented version-history, diff, or rollback workflow, and signal/alert edits via the CLI show no version tracking (docs-36, docs-42). Missing for 10: documented rollback/version-history UI or CLI commands, versioning of signals and alerts, review/approval workflow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
